title: DriftDisplay - 2D per-voice scatter (timing vs pitch), color-coded markers, fading trail history, atomic polling, V3/V4 hidden at voiceCount==2
description:
Implement Source/GUI/DriftDisplay.h and Source/GUI/DriftDisplay.cpp — the signature ShredDouble diagnostic (ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §9.4).

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/DSP/MeterTap.h (getVoiceDelayMs / getVoiceDetuneCents or equivalent 2*V atomic load APIs set in c.2)
- Source/GUI/GoniometerComponent.h/.cpp and CorrelationMeter.h/.cpp (Component paint/update patterns, MeterTap pointer style)
- Source/GUI/CustomLookAndFeel.h (colors/palette if reusable)
- .abracapocus/ShredDouble_Build_Spec.md §9.4 and §9.5

Implement class DriftDisplay : public juce::Component:
1. 2-D scatter field: X-axis = each voice's current timing offset relative to nominal (ms); Y-axis = current pitch offset (cents). Draw labelled axes, grid/crosshair at (0,0), and clip markers to plot bounds.
2. One color-coded marker per active voice (distinct hues for V1..V4). Each marker trails a short fading history ring buffer (preallocated, fixed capacity, e.g. 32–64 samples) so trails show independent breathing.
3. Poll MeterTap atomics only on the UI thread via update()/setMeterValues — load 2*V std::atomic<float> (tau_v_ms, deltaC_v) with relaxed loads. Do not block, lock, or allocate on update hot path after construct (preallocate trail buffers).
4. setVoiceCount(int) or setActiveVoices(int): when voiceCount==2, hide (do not draw or advance) voices 3 and 4 markers/trails; when 4, show all. Default assume 2 until told otherwise.
5. setMeterTap(MeterTap*) optional pointer like GoniometerComponent; update() pulls latest drifts then repaint(). Also allow external push of 8 floats if editor prefers pull from processor façade.
6. Axis ranges: scale X from timing spread domain (at least ±~15–20 ms usable) and Y from pitch domain (±~10–12 cents); keep ranges stable or lightly autoscaled with hysteresis so markers stay readable.
7. paint/resized only — no Timer inside DriftDisplay (editor owns 30–60 Hz Timer).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY DriftDisplay.h/.cpp. Do not edit PluginEditor or CMakeLists (d.2 owns those).
acceptance_criteria: DriftDisplay is a juce::Component drawing a 2-D scatter with X=timing offset ms and Y=pitch offset cents
DriftDisplay draws up to four color-coded voice markers each with a short fading trail history from preallocated buffers
DriftDisplay polls or accepts per-voice tau_v and deltaC_v values sourced from MeterTap atomics (2*V floats)
When voiceCount==2 (or active voice count 2), voices 3 and 4 markers and trails are not drawn
DriftDisplay update path performs no locks and no steady-state heap allocation after construction
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: modify the eight reused ShredWidth GUI/DSP files (CustomLookAndFeel, RotarySlider, GoniometerComponent, CorrelationMeter, PitchShifter, DelayLineFrac, MonoSafetyCrossover, WidthProcessor)
run a juce::Timer inside DriftDisplay (editor owns the timer)

allowed: fixed-capacity ring buffer trail per voice
distinct hard-coded marker colors for four voices
pull API via MeterTap* and/or explicit setVoiceDriftValues
stable axis ranges covering timingSpread/pitchSpread domains
forbidden: embed PluginEditor or APVTS dependencies inside DriftDisplay
allocate per-frame std::vector growth on update/paint
implement strip-chart companion as default-required UI (optional later only)
